rows.title: Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
rows.summary: SKF India (Industrial) Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP

rows.title: Change in Management
rows.summary: With reference to our intimation dated 11th August 2026, pursuant to Regulation 30 and other applicable provisions of SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements Regulation), 2015 ( SEBI LODR ) read with SEBI Master Circular no. HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026 dated 30th January 2026 ( SEBI Master Circular ),  we wish to inform change in designation of Mr. Sujeeth Pai (DIN: 07763929) from Whole-Time Director to Managing Director of the Company with effect from 1st September 2026, subject to the approval of the shareholders.

rows.title: Appointment
rows.summary: With reference to our intimation dated 11th August 2026, pursuant to Regulation 30 and Para A Part A of Schedule III and other applicable provisions of SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements Regulation), 2015 ( SEBI LODR ) read with SEBI Master Circular no. HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026 dated 30th January 2026, we wish to inform you that Mr. Mukund Vasudevan (DIN: 05146681) has been appointed as Non-Executive, Non-Independent Director of the Company with effect from 1st September 2026, subject to the approval of Shareholders.

rows.title: Cessation
rows.summary: With reference to our intimation dated 11th August 2026, we hereby inform you that Mr. MukundVasudevan (DIN: 05146681) has resigned from the office of Managing Director of SKF India(Industrial) Limited with effect from the closure of business hours on 31st August 2026, pursuant to a change in his role within the SKF Group.
